purpose: Isolate the four network behaviours the baseline capture destroyed - a retry that recovers, a poll where nothing varies, a rate-limit backoff, and an observed 5xx - so M2.5 network evidence is proven on an application that really produces them rather than on a hand-written event list.
targeted_defect: Regression guard for T-NET-01 (network events stamped on a raw monotonic epoch could never fall inside a visit window), T-NET-02 (dedup on method|url|status collapsed three retries into one record), T-NET-03 (no event named the UI action that caused it) and T-NET-05 (the oracle read start_ms while the crawler wrote timestamp_ms, silently disabling the step window).
lane_note: jsdom has no network stack, so a fixture whose whole subject is the ORDER and COUNT of real HTTP requests cannot be measured there. Declaring both lanes would report a lane that never ran as one that passed.
